\chapter{Boolean Analysis --- Bobkov}
%%% generated by the blueprint pipeline from TCSlib.BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.Bobkov
\section{Overview}
Bobkov's functional measures the expected Euclidean length of a Gaussian profile together with the discrete gradient. The cube inequality bounds the profile of the mean, and the functional is monotone in the Boolean noise correlation.

\section{Declarations}

\begin{definition}[Expected profile-gradient length]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.bobkovFunctional}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BooleanFunc,BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.closedGaussianProfile,BooleanAnalysis.derivative,BooleanAnalysis.expect}
For a real function $f$ on the uniform Boolean cube $\{0,1\}^n$, write $D_i f(x)=(f(x^{i\leftarrow0})-f(x^{i\leftarrow1}))/2$ and $B(f)=\mathbb E\sqrt{\overline I(f)^2+\sum_i(D_i f)^2}$, where $\overline I$ is the Gaussian profile extended by zero outside $(0,1)$. The Bobkov functional assigns the value $B(f)$ to $f$.
\end{definition}

\begin{theorem}[Bobkov two-point inequality]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.bobkov_two_point}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.closedGaussianProfile,BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.closedGaussianProfile_one,BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.closedGaussianProfile_two_point_of_mem_Ioo,BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.closedGaussianProfile_zero}
\difficulty{4}
Let $\Phi,\varphi$ be the standard Gaussian distribution function and density, and let $\overline I(p)=\varphi(\Phi^{-1}(p))$ for $0<p<1$, with $\overline I(p)=0$ elsewhere. For real $a,b$ with $a+b,a-b\in[0,1]$, $\overline I(a)\le\bigl(\sqrt{\overline I(a+b)^2+b^2}+\sqrt{\overline I(a-b)^2+b^2}\bigr)/2$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{lemma}[Profile of the restricted means]
